eps.ov: Despite his best efforts, level 999 villager Kagami gets involved in a quest to hunt the Demon King.
Kagami agrees to help Alice and introduces her to a friend.
Kagami foils a demonic attack on the city and learns about darker forces at play.
As monsters attack Salmaria, the Hero's party begins to doubt their convictions.
The battle for Salmaria seems to be going well, until an unexpected visitor drops in.
Kagami and his friends kick off a new adventure: trying to start a casino in Valman!

eps.t: You're Changed by the People You Meet
eps.ov: An unexpected new ally has contributed to the casino's opening, but trouble is brewing behind the scenes.
While Kagami and Menow pursue a quicker way to earn money, Alice struggles with suspicions back in Valman.
At the end of a mysterious dungeon, Kagami and Menow learn more than they expected.
The heroes regroup and plot their next course of action in light of recent events.
Kagami and friends storm the castle to try to negotiate with the king, but find Parna waiting for them.
Kagami makes a last-ditch offer to save his friends and right the wrongs in the world.
